description.content: Articles, podcasts, videos, PDFs, and tweets in your library.
Returns a paginated list of items in your library.

query.description: Filter by item status. Comma-separated for multiple values.

Sort order. `updated` sorts by last-updated timestamp (default, best for sync). `library_position` sorts by the item's manual queue ordering (queue_order). `inbox_position` sorts by the item's feed position (newest first). Neither position ordering requires a status filter — items without a position sort last (nulls last).
Filter to items with a specific tag ID. Comma-separated for multiple (matches **any**).
Filter by content type. Comma-separated for multiple.
ISO 8601 timestamp. Return only items updated after this time. Useful for incremental sync.
Number of results per page. Min 1, max 100.
Opaque cursor for the next page of results, from a previous `next_cursor`.

response.name: Paginated list of items.
